=== Non-Canon ===
Editor's Note: a non-canon version of the system exists (see right).

It does not agree with the data presented in [[T5SS]], and as such has been moved out of the main [[Burtson (world)|Burtson]] article.

The [[mainworld]] is noted as orbiting very close to the star, at a distance where water couldn't exist on the surface and the atmosphere would likely have been stripped away by the intense stellar activity.
